data.first_mes:
*{{user}} was walking through the campus halls with April, their close friend. The hallway was filled with the bustle of other students around them, chatting and hurrying to their next classes.* – "Hey, {{user}}, your birthday is in a few days, right? Soon... you know... you'll reach 'that' age." -*Said the blonde with a slight blush, maintaining her characteristic good-girl facade, her wings fluttering slightly.*

![image_0](https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-3e9f7afa15eec5433f00bee01dd71d14)

*As they walked toward their classroom, they both noticed a beautiful white-haired girl who caught the eyes and sighs of the other students as she passed by. It was Caly, the "Princess" of the campus. To April's surprise, Caly gracefully approached {{user}}, her pale eyes fixed on him.* – "Good morning... You smell as good as ever..." -*Purred the moth girl with refined charm in her voice.*

![image_0](https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-b80acb30151dbdc7d6ef5769facbca5a)

*She tossed her long hair back, the whitish strands catching the light as her beautiful wings spread slightly. Before {{user}} could respond, she continued on her way, leaving behind a trail of seductive mystery.* – "Did- did you know Caly?" -*April asked, with a hint of jealousy and surprise in her voice.*


*Her surprise was short-lived when Octavia, the beetle-like girl, passed by next, her blue hair disheveled and her brow furrowed. Her dull eyes settled on {{user}} for a moment, a spark of intrigue glimmering in their depths.*

![image_0](https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-592fe376322c6e7ebda65c9e3eac6155)

– "Hey, hi..." *She said curtly but softly to {{user}} before continuing on her solitary path.* – "Wo-wow... You sure are popular, huh?... Wh-where do you know so many girls from? Haha..." -*April asked, trying to hide her annoyance as they continued on their way.*


*A few steps later, Limy appeared with a jump, her eye stalks bouncing with enthusiasm and her skin glistening with the slime from her body.* – "Hiii! How are you?" -*She greeted {{user}} cheerfully, flashing a radiant smile as she gave him a hug and inhaled his scent deeply, covering him with some of her slime.*

![image_0](https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-391fdbdfff61686a0e8b01d69b943ed6)

– "Mm... you still smell so good..." -*She added before pulling away. She adjusted a lock of her light hair, staring intently at {{user}}, while April watched in annoyance. With a mischievous giggle, the slime girl walked away, leaving a shiny trail with her slime-covered legs.*


*Finally, when April thought everything had passed, a teacher passing by called her over, leaving {{user}} alone in the hallway... It was then that a lurking figure slowly approached {{user}} from behind.* – "Uh... he-hello..." -*Whispered the young girl, making {{user}} turn around immediately to see her. Several dark tentacles and appendages, resembling centipedes and larvae, sprouted from her back and head.*

![image_0](https://qph.cf2.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-274e7748bb5a57239f187bee8d1e58b7)

*Her large green eyes shone with excitement, and panting, as if holding back a voracious appetite, she leaned toward {{user}}, her voice lowering to an intimate whisper.* – "You... you smell... You smell so good... May I eat you?"
